symptom: ako/mxcli#854 (follow-up of #842): an action on a data grid filter (`OnChange:` on textfilter / numberfilter / datefilter / dropdownfilter), a barcode scanner (`onDetect:`) or a combo box's onEnterEvent / onLeaveEvent / onChangeFilterInputEvent was refused under `mdl 1;` (4x MDL-WIDGET37, 4x MDL-WIDGET06 on one page) and dropped with MDL-V1-ACTIONSLOT / MDL-WIDGET06 warnings under mdl 0; describe printed no filter action, so a Studio Pro-authored one could not be restated, retargeted or removed. Third bullet: `alter page … set (Action: …) on <gallery>` was refused ("has no on-click action — Action can only be set on a widget that has one") while `set ('onClick': …)` wrote the same slot, and no ALTER spelling applied MDL-WIDGET36 — on an 11.13.0 app the quoted form under `mdl 1;` was written and mx check then failed: "The item click action is ambiguous" at Gallery 'gSingle', 1 error. Fourth bullet: an enumeration value of a pluggable widget was stored as written — `onClickTrigger: Double` / `triple` and a data grid's `pagination: 'Buttons'` all stored verbatim, mx check (11.13.0, with and without the widget update) 0 errors.
cause: These widgets' definitions are hand-written and embedded (sdk/widgets/definitions), and a hand-written def beats the generator that maps every action slot of a generated widget. Theirs mapped none of these slots, so resolveMapping never read the action; describe's filter branch read no action and the known-type output branch printed no named slots. The combo box's onChangeDatabaseEvent named in the issue was already fixed by mendixlabs/mxcli#1583 (database mode, sourced from OnChange). ALTER's `Action` key went to SetWidgetAction, the built-in widget's click property (Action / OnClickAction / ClickAction), which a pluggable widget does not have; its click is the action-typed property its definition reads `onClick:` from. MDL-WIDGET36 lived only in the CREATE validator, which reads the statement's AST — an ALTER carries no widget. Neither the engine's primitive writes (mapping pass, explicit-property pass) nor ALTER's pluggable setter compared a value with the keys the widget's schema declares, and no check rule did for a top-level property (MDL-WIDGET08 covered object-list items only) — for generated and hand-written definitions alike.
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/{text,number,date,dropdown}filter.def.json (onChange <- OnChange, in every mode of the dropdown filter), barcodescanner.def.json (onDetect named), combobox.def.json (onEnterEvent / onLeaveEvent / onChangeFilterInputEvent named, in all three modes) + modelsdk mirrors; mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (filter OnChange, combo box NamedActions); cmd_pages_describe_output.go (known-type branch prints named slots, which no longer route a combo box into the generic branch); widget_named_action_slot.go (embeddedSourcedActionKeys: a slot a def sources from OnClick/OnChange under a key actionSourceForKey does not know — onChangeDatabaseEvent — is not also printed by key); mdl/executor/alter_set_click_action.go (setClickAction: Action / onClick reach a pluggable widget's click slot; checkGalleryClickAfterSet / storedGalleryClickAmbiguity judge the stored gallery after the SET); cmd_alter_page.go; validate_alter_set.go (checkGalleryClickSet on a probe copy); mdl/backend/pagemutator/pluggable_state.go (PluggableWidgetState capability); mdl/executor/widget_enum_value.go (enumerationValue in the engine, validatePluggableEnumValues for check -p, gateUndeclaredEnum, MDL-V1-WIDGETENUM in validate_widget_language.go); mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder.go (EnumerationKeys, read from the Type the build writes); widget_known_props_from_mpk.go (def.enumKeys from the installed .mpk); alter_set_pluggable_attribute.go + pagemutator/pluggable_attribute.go (PluggablePropertyScope.EnumKeys)
insight: Test the hypothesis before fixing the half that may already be fixed: the 'filter onChange lost on rebuild' bullet already held on main through #832's per-property patch (statement and shadow build both wrote NoAction, so the stored action was kept) — proven by seeding a Studio Pro-shaped Forms$MicroflowAction into the filter's onChange, editing the filter via describe->exec, and stubbing patchStoredPluggable as the control (fails 'reset its onChange to Forms$NoAction'); a sibling edit needed patch AND passthrough stubbed to fail. What the mapping adds is that describe can SAY the action, so a statement can keep, retarget or remove it. The cheap audit for this class is mechanical: TestBuiltinDefsMapEveryActionSlot diffs each embedded def's action mappings against the action properties its .mpk declares (testdata), and requires a named slot in EVERY mode — selectMappings ignores top-level mappings of a def with modes. Spell new slots the way the generator would (actionSourceForKey): `onChange` -> `OnChange:`, anything else by its own key. A def-sourced slot under an unusual key (onChangeDatabaseEvent) must be excluded from describe's by-key list or it is printed twice. Real mx check (11.13.0, --no-update-widgets): all eight actions written, 0 errors, describe->exec 'Unchanged page'; fault variant: refused under mdl 1, 0 errors under mdl 0 with every action missing. For a whole-widget rule on ALTER, judge the STORED widget after the SET, not the SET: a gallery's ambiguity is three settings (Gallery editorConfig: `"None" !== itemSelection && onClick && "single" === onClickTrigger`), of which one SET may name one. Do it in exec (refuse before Save under mdl 1, warn under mdl 0) and in check on a Probe() copy with the whole op applied. A SET cannot write a Selection-typed property (columnValueField), so the advice for the selection route is `replace`. mx check is NOT the oracle for an enumeration value — it accepted Double, triple and Buttons at 0 errors; the widget's runtime bundle is (Gallery.mjs: `"single"===e.clickTrigger` / `"double"===e.clickTrigger`, so a stored Double makes the row click dead). Note the testdata .mpk files have their JS bundles stripped to 0 bytes; read the runtime code from an app's widgets/ folder. Split the fix by kind: a key in another case is a silent wrong write, normalised under both versions; a value with no key is a new rejection, gated (MDL-V1-WIDGETENUM -> MDL-WIDGET08). Check validates only with -p, from the installed package's keys — without a project it cannot know a newer widget's keys and stays silent rather than refuse. A def value-mapping authored by its own key (gallery onClickTrigger) is written twice, by the mapping pass and the explicit pass, so report it once.
